name: Chouchin
source: A Chouchin type monster girl. Chouchin are similar to anglerfish and this Chouchin has a light on her head. She was sexually tortured by [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url] in an effort to force her loyalty in murdering [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url]. She is a very kindhearted girl however and desperately hopes to be captured by Leo rather than have to kill anyone. Still, because of her deep fear of Baron Squid she still tries to defeat him.
